Action.Dna: The DNA action's payload (the first action of every source chain).
CellId.CellId: A cell id from its DNA hash and agent public key.
CloneCellId.FromCloneId: Identify a clone cell by its clone id (e.g. "oasis.0").
CloneCellId.FromDnaHash: Identify a clone cell by its DNA hash.
DhtOp.StoreRecord: A StoreRecord op: the signature, the action and the entry.
DnaDefinition.CoordinatorZomes: The DNA's coordinator zomes (hot-swappable with UpdateCoordinatorsAsync).
DnaDefinition.IntegrityZomes: The DNA's integrity zomes (entry/link types and validation; they define the DNA hash).
DnaDefinition.Modifiers: The DNA modifiers (network seed, properties, origin time) that make this DNA's hash.
DnaDefinition.Name: The DNA's name.
EnableAppError.Error: Why a cell could not be enabled.
HoloNETClientAppBase.CachedAppInfo: The last app_info this client received (agent, DNA, cells, status).
HoloNETClientAppBase.OnAgentInfoReturned: Fired when a response arrives for GetAgentInfoAsync (app interface).
HoloNETClientAppBase.OnAppEnabledCallBac: Fired when a response arrives for EnableAppAsync (app interface, e.g. after providing membrane proofs).
HoloNETClientAppBase.OnDirectSignalCapab: Fired when a response arrives for GrantDirectSignalCapabilityAsync.
HoloNETClientAppBase.OnDirectSignalSentC: Fired when a response arrives for SendDirectSignalAsync.
HoloNETClientAppBase.OnNetworkMetricsDum: Fired when a response arrives for DumpNetworkMetricsAsync (app interface).
HoloNETClientAppBase.OnNetworkStatsDumpe: Fired when a response arrives for DumpNetworkStatsAsync (app interface).
HoloNETClientAppBase.CreateAuthenticatio: The authenticate message HoloNET sends first on an app interface, carrying the app authentication token.
HoloNETClientBase.DeserializeResponseVal: Decode a conductor response envelope's value as T (MessagePack).
HoloNETDNA.ErrorHandlingBehaviour: Whether errors only raise OnError (the default) or also throw.
HoloNETResponse.HoloNETResponseType: Which kind of message this is (zome call response, signal, admin response...).
IZomeCallSigner.SignZomeCallAsync: Sign a zome call (implement this to sign with an external key store, e.g. a mobile runtime).
ProvideMemproofsRequest.MembraneProofs: The membrane proof for each role (role name -> proof bytes).
SignalData.CellData: The cell id the signal came from ([DNA hash, agent public key]).
SignalData.Data: The signal payload as MessagePack bytes (what the zome passed to emit_signal).
Signature.Signature: A signature from its 64 raw bytes.
SourceChainCursor.ActionHash: Start a source chain dump at this action.
SourceChainCursor.Sequence: Start a source chain dump at this action sequence number.
ZomeCallParamsSigned.ZomeCallParamsSigne: Signed zome call parameters: the serialised call and its signature.
ZomeCallToSign.CellIdAgentPubKey: The agent public key of the cell being called.
ZomeCallToSign.CellIdDnaHash: The DNA hash of the cell being called.
ZomeDefinition.Dependencies: The integrity zomes this coordinator zome depends on.
CapAccess.Assigned: A grant only these agents may use, with this secret (what HoloNET uses for zome-call signing).
CapAccess.Transferable: A grant anyone holding this secret may use.
CapAccess.Unrestricted: A grant anyone may use (Holochain 0.7 rejects this for zome-call signing; fine for e.g. recv_remote_signal).
KitsuneAgent.KitsuneAgent: A Kitsune (Holochain networking) agent id from its raw bytes.
KitsuneSignature.KitsuneSignature: A Kitsune signature from its raw bytes.
KitsuneSpace.KitsuneSpace: A Kitsune space (a DNA's network) id from its raw bytes.
IDnaModifiers.OriginTime: The DNA's origin time (part of what makes its hash).
HoloNETCollectionSavedResult.ConductorRe: Every zome call the save made.
HoloNETCollectionSavedResult.EntiesAdded: Entries added to the collection by this save.
HoloNETCollectionSavedResult.EntiesRemov: Entries removed from the collection by this save.
HoloNETCollectionSavedResult.EntiesSaved: Entries created or updated by this save.
HoloNETCollectionSavedResult.EntiesSaveE: Entries that failed to save (see ErrorMessages).
HoloNETCollection.ReCalculateEntriesAdde: Recompute EntriesAddedSinceLastSaved / EntriesRemovedSinceLastSaved from the current list.
HoloNETObservableCollection.ReCalculateE: Recompute EntriesAddedSinceLastSaved / EntriesRemovedSinceLastSaved from the current list.
IHoloNETCollection.ReCalculateEntriesAdd: Recompute EntriesAddedSinceLastSaved / EntriesRemovedSinceLastSaved from the current list.
HoloNETEntryBase.MockData: Fill every mapped property with sample values (for tests and demos).
HappFieldSpec.HappFieldSpec: A field with this C# name and type.
HappSpec.CSharpNamespace: The namespace of the generated C# models.
HappSpec.HolochainVersion: The Holochain version to target (picks the hdk / hdi crates).
HappSpec.Name: The hApp's name (also its DNA and role name, in snake_case).
HappZomeSpec.Name: The zome's name.
HoloNETAPIDNAManager.HoloNETAPIDNA: The HoloNET API settings in use.
HoloNETAPIDNAManager.HoloNETAPIDNAPath: Where HoloNETAPIDNA.json is read from and saved to.
HyperNETSession.Deserialize: Read a typed message sent with SendAsync<T> (MessagePack, contractless).
